title: Simple Views
description: Create and use simple and materialized views.

data.title: View
data.code:
CREATE VIEW active_users AS
SELECT id, email, display_name
FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

data.title: Materialized View
data.code:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW user_stats AS
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total) AS lifetime
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id;

data.title: Tip
data.text: Create UNIQUE index on materialized views for REFRESH CONCURRENTLY.
